question: The sum of the ages of Sarala and Kishore is 26 years. If 3 years ago, Kishore was (3)/(2) times as old as Sarala, then the present age of Sarala is:
solution:
**Given** :

The sum of the ages of Sarala and Kishore is 26 years.

3 years ago, Kishore was (3)/(2) times as old as the Sarala.

**Calculation :**

Let present age of Sarala be x years and present age of Kishore be y years.

**According to question,**

 
• x + y = 26
 
• (x - 3) = 4(y - 3)

Sum of present ages of Sarala and Kishore is 26 years.

⇒ x + y = 26

⇒ x = 26 - y ----------- (1)

 3 years ago , Kishore was (3)/(2) times as old as Sarala.

⇒ (y - 3) = (3)/(2) (x - 3)

⇒2y - 6 = 3x - 9

⇒ 3x - 2y = 3

⇒ 3 (26 - y) - 2y = 3 --------- from(1)

⇒78 - 3y - 2y = 3

⇒ 78 - 3 = 5y 

⇒y = 15 ------------ (2)

Now, from (1) and (2),

⇒ x= 26 -15

⇒ x =11 

Hence,** The present age of Sarala is 11 years.**
